## Overview

This script produces a world map of NMDB neutron monitor stations, where:

- **Color** represents the RÂ² value between CARI-7A modelled neutron flux and the observed NM count rate (from S7).
- **Point size** is proportional to the number of valid paired measurements (n).

Stations with higher RÂ² (warmer colors) show stronger agreement between the CARI-7A model and ground observations. Stations with fewer measurements appear as smaller points.

---

## Step 1: Load packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(ggrepel)
```

---

## Step 2: Load data

```{r load_data}
# RÂ² results from S7
r2 <- read_csv("../dataset/outcomes/from_s7/r2_results.csv")

# Station coordinates from S8 input
coords <- read_csv("../dataset/inputs/s8/nmdb_stations_final.csv")

# Join by station name
df <- r2 %>%
  inner_join(coords, by = "station")

cat("Stations matched:", nrow(df), "\n")
head(df)
```

---

## Step 3: Draw world map

```{r world_map, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
world <- map_data("world")

p <- ggplot() +
  # World base map
  geom_polygon(
    data  = world,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill  = "grey92",
    color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  # Station points
  geom_point(
    data  = df,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = R2, size = n),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  # Station labels for high-RÂ² stations
  geom_text_repel(
    data        = df %>% filter(R2 >= 0.5),
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = station),
    size        = 2.5,
    color       = "black",
    max.overlaps = 20,
    segment.size = 0.3
  ) +
  # Color scale: low RÂ² = cool blue, high RÂ² = warm red
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low      = "steelblue",
    mid      = "yellow",
    high     = "red",
    midpoint = 0.5,
    limits   = c(0, 1),
    name     = "RÂ²"
  ) +
  # Size scale proportional to n
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2, 10),
    name  = "n (measurements)"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90)) +
  labs(
    title    = "NMDB Station Correlations: CARI-7A Modelled vs Observed Neutron Flux",
    subtitle = "Color = RÂ²  |  Point size = number of valid paired measurements",
    x        = "Longitude",
    y        = "Latitude",
    caption  = "Stations with RÂ² â¥ 0.5 are labelled. Period: 2000â2026."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid    = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

print(p)

# Save output
output_dir <- "../dataset/outcomes/from_s8"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "world_map_r2.png"),
  plot     = p,
  width    = 14,
  height   = 7,
  dpi      = 150
)
cat("Map saved to", file.path(output_dir, "world_map_r2.png"), "\n")
```

---

## Step 4: Export merged table

```{r export_table}
output_dir <- "../dataset/outcomes/from_s8"

df_out <- df %>%
  select(station, lat, lon, alt_m, n, R2, r, p_value, slope, intercept) %>%
  arrange(desc(R2))

write_csv(df_out, file.path(output_dir, "r2_with_coords.csv"))
cat("Table saved to", file.path(output_dir, "r2_with_coords.csv"), "\n")

df_out
```

---

## Step 5: Summary statistics

```{r summary}
cat("Total stations mapped:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Stations with RÂ² >= 0.5:", sum(df$R2 >= 0.5), "\n")
cat("Stations with RÂ² >= 0.7:", sum(df$R2 >= 0.7), "\n")
cat("Median RÂ²:", round(median(df$R2), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean RÂ²:", round(mean(df$R2), 3), "\n")
```
